title: Schedule of Cancellation Terms for KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
The cancellation figures of KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts are set per coverage level in the schedule below. Most are uniform; the deduction of claims from a pro rata refund differs between levels.

## Free look, fee and refund basis

| Coverage level | Free-look period (calendar days after the sale date, sale date is day 0) | Full free-look refund requires that no claim has been paid | Cancellation fee on a pro rata refund (USD) | Used share for a pro rata refund | Net claims paid deducted from a pro rata refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 60 | yes | 50.00 | greater of time or miles | yes |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 60 | yes | 50.00 | greater of time or miles | yes |
| KestrelCare Silver | 60 | yes | 50.00 | greater of time or miles | yes |
| KestrelCare Gold | 60 | yes | 50.00 | greater of time or miles | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 60 | yes | 50.00 | greater of time or miles | no |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 60 | yes | 50.00 | greater of time or miles | no |

## Flat cancellation, payee, request and timing

| Coverage level | Reasons that cancel from inception with a full refund and no fee | Refund of a financed plan goes to the lienholder while the finance contract is active | Dated odometer statement required to cancel | Days a request may await the customer's signed form before it lapses (calendar days) | Refund issued within (business days after the cancellation is confirmed) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | vehicle returned | yes | yes | 14 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | vehicle returned | yes | yes | 14 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Silver | vehicle returned | yes | yes | 14 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Gold | vehicle returned | yes | yes | 14 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | vehicle returned | yes | yes | 14 | 30 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | vehicle returned | yes | yes | 14 | 30 |

"Vehicle returned" is the return of the vehicle under the Kestrel 7-day return.

## Notes on the schedule

- The free-look period counts the sale date as day 0, so a request on day 60 is inside it and a request on day 61 is not.
- "Greater of time or miles" means the used share of the contract is measured both by time and by miles and the larger of the two is used.
- The cancellation fee and the deduction of claims concern a pro rata refund only; a flat cancellation carries neither.
- A cancellation request that has waited 14 calendar days without the customer's signed form lapses.
